Olivia Nguyen: FYI support case — v1 SDK falls back to embed_xsmall when an alias is unresolved; customer index expected 1536d but got 128d.
Matt Chen: Yikes. Is there a repro?
Olivia Nguyen: Yes: call embed with an alias that was removed. Quickstart snippets don't pin model IDs so this is easy to hit.
Raj Patel: We should add a migration caveat and CI smoke test to catch vector-dim mismatches.
Sophia Li: I'll draft a short migration note and banner. Copy: 'If you rely on model aliases, verify embedding model and vector dimensionality after migration; pin model IDs in production.'
Matt Chen: I'll update quickstart snippets to pin model IDs (TS/py). Example change: `await client.embed({ model: 'h2o-embed-1536', input: 'hi' })`
Raj Patel: I'll open a CI PR that runs a snippet and asserts len(vec) == expected_dim. Will gate failure unless docs-owner label present.
Olivia Nguyen: Plan: Sophia drafts docs PR, Matt updates snippets, Raj adds smoke test. ETA EOD Thursday.
docs-bot: Issue created: "docs: embed alias fallback caveat" (#4827)
ci-bot: Smoke test queued: docs-embed-dim-check
Raj Patel: Smoke runner passes in staging (1536) — PR WIP: https://ci.example.internal/pulls/128
Sophia Li: Draft pushed to branch `docs/alias-embed-caveat` for review.
Olivia Nguyen: After merge add changelog entry and support blurb. I'll coordinate comms.
ci-bot: Smoke test completed: PASS (vector dim 1536)
Olivia Nguyen: Merged. Closing loop, thanks team.
